name: cyclic_rule_completion_with_adaptive_relaxation
scientific_claim: Full-batch training first memorizes observed pairs, then a distributed composition rule makes unseen-pair logit margins uniformly positive. After formation, Adam second-moment relaxation can cause clipped excursions, but the same full-batch rule gradients restore the formed capability.

state_variables.rule_completion_fraction: validation-grid fraction whose learned rule margin is positive, represented by validation accuracy
state_variables.adaptive_risk: LOW, HIGH, or EXCURSION state of the optimizer relaxation oscillator
state_variables.effective_optimizer_updates: parameter-changing updates; this differs from declared step only under the intervention

primitive_gfg_bindings: evaluation facts read exact parameter-version outcomes
batch materialization facts identify the repeated complete training source
forward/loss, backward, clipping, and optimizer fact blocks bind each source to its concrete outcome
GeneratedOrigin binds each new parameter and optimizer-state version into later occurrences

formation_transition.guard: an earlier validation accuracy is at most 0.30 and three consecutive grid evaluations have train accuracy at least 0.99 and validation accuracy at least 0.90
formation_transition.forecast_estimator: snap(cut_step + 150 + 1000 * max(0, 0.90 - current_validation_accuracy)) to the observed evaluation grid
formation_transition.high_precision_interval: estimate plus or minus one evaluation interval
formation_transition.primary_interval: estimate plus or minus two evaluation intervals

preconditions: formed rule with a broad positive unseen-pair margin
decayed Adam exp_avg_sq followed by an adaptive update excursion
stability_transition.degradation: a parameter version formed during the excursion loses train and validation rule margins
stability_transition.recovery: large full-batch gradients are clipped and subsequent exact optimizer generations rebuild positive margins
